# Gram panchayat reservation with 2011 Census counts

`up_gp_reservation_2005_2010_census_2011.dta` (Stata, 24666 rows, SHA-256 `910306d6564405dee89af964cd1138ff2ece5656dc8b3b96defddda1f217da92`) lists village panchayats in 30 districts plus one, with 2005 and 2010 seat-reservation indicators (`reserved_05`, `sc_reserved_05`, `female_reserved_10`, …), 2011 Census population and literacy counts, and a `selected_panchayat` flag.

It was added in the repository's initial commit (2024-05-05) as `Uttar Pradesh_All panchayats_30 districts plus one_panchayatwise.dta`; the file is dated 2022-12-12. Its author and sampling rule are not recorded, and no code here reads it. Treat it as outside research data, not an SEC source.
